destination.title: Inflationary persistence, realization and consistency
destination.question: Under which source-specific dynamical, quantum and effective-theory assumptions can inflation begin, persist, end and produce viable cosmological histories?
destination.summary: A navigation family spanning ordinary inflation and conditional quantum-gravity tests. Different mechanisms and definitions of persistence remain distinct. Numerical proximity supplies candidate membership only.

systems: Scalar inflation, including assisted, hilltop, hybrid, noncanonical and multifield models
Defects, metastable vacua and alternative quantum descriptions of expansion
targets: Conditional consistency, initial preparation, controlled realization and exit
Source-specific observables and connections to later cosmology
regimes: Slow roll and explicitly identified departures from slow roll
Source-specific spacetime dimensions and gravitational frameworks
assumptions: Quantum-gravity conjectures apply only where a source adopts or tests them
Local quantum dominance, global volume growth and persistence along a worldline are different tests
conventions: Retain each source's field normalization, gravitational frame and Planck-mass convention
excludes: Treating numerical membership as scientific equivalence
A universal conclusion about all mechanisms of eternal inflation
Treating post-inflationary scalar evolution alone as an inflationary survival mechanism

sources.title: Eternal Chaotic Inflation is Prohibited by Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can self-reproduction occur in the simple massive or quartic regimes of an assisted chaotic potential? The two contributions share a common field amplitude and total Hubble friction, but the conjectured cutoff remains tied to the quartic coupling.

sources.title: Eternal Chaotic Inflation is Prohibited by Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quantum fluctuations sustain self-reproduction in an assisted chaotic inflation model while the effective inflaton theory obeys a conjectured gravitational ultraviolet cutoff? The question concerns slow-roll eternal inflation rather than persistent expansion of metastable vacua.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation: Prohibited by Quantum Gravity?

evidence.text: Do quantum-gravity principles and selected phenomenological models obstruct slow-roll or false-vacuum eternal inflation, and do these obstructions suggest a general prohibition?

sources.title: Warped Hybrid Inflation

evidence.text: Can hybrid inflation combine a naturally flat PNGB inflaton potential with a rapid waterfall exit while avoiding excessive waterfall-loop corrections, using controlled five-dimensional effective field theory?

sources.title: Simple exercises to flatten your potential

evidence.text: When does relaxation of heavy scalar fields in response to inflationary energy flatten the canonically normalized inflaton potential, and when do kinetic effects or loss of moduli stabilization prevent this mechanism?

sources.title: Tunnelling in Dante's Inferno

evidence.text: When can quantum tunnelling across the transverse potential barrier terminate inflation in Dante’s Inferno, and what additional restrictions follow from requiring its suppression during inflation?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: How do a single inflaton's potential slope and quantum fluctuations compare during approximately de Sitter expansion? The analysis uses potential-dominated slow roll and a canonically normalized scalar, as implicit in the displayed evolution equations.

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Which restrictions on scalar trajectories and positive potentials are assumed when testing inflation against the proposed quantum-gravity criteria?

sources.title: Isocurvature Perturbations of Dark Energy and Dark Matter from the Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: How does a lower bound on the inflaton potential gradient translate into an inflationary Hubble scale and tensor amplitude?

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: The setting concerns quantum versus classical inflaton evolution in Einstein gravity. A conventional slow-roll comparison and a separate acceleration-retaining turnaround calculation share potential domination, but their scalar equations of motion use different approximations.

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: When does a light inflaton's typical quantum displacement over a Hubble time exceed its classical displacement? The paper uses this comparison to identify diffusion zones and motivate continued inflation in some spatial regions.

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the slope-or-negative-curvature restriction act on a canonical inflaton, and which observables test it? The chosen variables are the potential slow-roll parameters εV and ηV.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: How do a canonical inflaton's potential, classical motion, and expansion rate determine whether quantum fluctuations can dominate? The background is flat FLRW, with potential energy providing nearly de Sitter expansion.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can eternal inflation near a single-field potential maximum coexist with the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns a tachyonic hilltop branch that avoids the original positive-gradient requirement.

sources.title: Transplanckian axion monodromy!?

evidence.text: Can the spatial monodromy mechanism be embedded in a time-dependent positive-energy background suitable for inflation?

sources.title: Stochastic eternal inflation is in the swampland

evidence.text: The local potential family tests whether inflation can persist near a maximum or inflection point while quantum kicks compete with outward classical drift. The retained quadratic term matters for satisfying a finite tachyonic-curvature requirement.

sources.title: Stochastic eternal inflation is in the swampland

evidence.text: The setting asks when quantum fluctuations can compete with classical inflaton motion while spacetime remains semiclassical. Higher-derivative interactions are represented through a sound speed, but the central curvature argument uses the unit-sound-speed limit.

sources.title: Stochastic eternal inflation is in the swampland

evidence.text: Can stochastic quantum kicks prolong single-field inflation in a potential whose small slope is accompanied by the negative curvature demanded by the refined de Sitter conjecture? The question includes whether the fluctuation calculation remains controlled.

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: A coarse-grained scalar in quasi-de Sitter space undergoes classical potential-driven drift and random horizon-crossing fluctuations. The competition determines how long regions remain inflationary.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation in Swampy Landscapes

evidence.text: Can a landscape support eternal inflation through expanding walls when no minimum or sufficiently flat hilltop can do so?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation in Swampy Landscapes

evidence.text: Can an eternally inflating multiverse exist when positive-energy minima are rare, or when all minima are nonpositive and hilltops cannot support stochastic eternal inflation?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Inflation in Grand Unified Theories

evidence.text: Can the vacuum energy driving hybrid inflation be made much smaller than the underlying U(1)-breaking scale?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can inflation be modeled by time-dependent access to causal-diamond degrees of freedom rather than stationary dS evolution? The supplied pages announce such a framework and its black-hole-gas aftermath without presenting the later construction.

sources.title: A potential mechanism for inflation from swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can integrating out states whose masses depend on an inflaton modulus flatten a steep geometric potential enough for slow roll while retaining the proposed quantum-gravity constraints?

sources.title: Topological Eternal Hilltop Inflation and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a defect establish a hilltop inflaton configuration and maintain eternal inflation while respecting a limited field excursion and an order-one potential-derivative bound? The paper investigates enhanced expansion on a brane as a possible route.

sources.title: Topological Eternal Hilltop Inflation and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: What maintains a hilltop configuration after inflation starts? The topological mechanism invokes a persistent defect retaining the potential maximum at its center, while the stochastic mechanism invokes fluctuating field trajectories.

sources.title: Swampland, Trans-Planckian Censorship and Fine-Tuning Problem for Inflation: Tunnelling Wavefunction to the Rescue

evidence.text: Can a quantum state of the universe select the small initial displacement and velocity needed for low-scale hilltop inflation, rather than assuming these conditions in classical phase space?

sources.title: Eternal inflation in light of Wheeler-DeWitt equation

evidence.text: Can higher-excitation solutions of the semiclassical Wheeler–DeWitt equation enlarge inflaton-displacement uncertainty and relax eternal-inflation conditions, and do nonlinear interactions or entropy favor the lowest excitation?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures and single-field inflation in nonstandard cosmological scenarios

evidence.text: The setting isolates how a modified relation between Hubble expansion and inflaton energy density changes inflationary dynamics while retaining a canonical scalar equation.

sources.title: Axion monodromy inflation, trapping mechanisms and the swampland

evidence.text: Can energy transfer into particles sustain inflation on a steep axion potential over a Planckian or smaller excursion? The paper compares self-production of the inflaton with repeated production of additional fields and asks whether either mechanism permits an exit.

sources.title: Eternal Chaotic Inflation is Prohibited by Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Compare the eternal threshold separately with each independent ceiling, then impose both parameter conditions together. The abstraction preserves which quantities are fixed during the field scan and which vary when observational normalization is subsequently imposed.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation: Prohibited by Quantum Gravity?

evidence.text: The author assembles conceptual critiques involving high-energy fluctuation suppression, complementarity, Planck-scale observer distinguishability, de Sitter observables and Boltzmann brains.

sources.title: Warped Hybrid Inflation

evidence.text: AdS/CFT motivates the construction: separate composite sectors have different compositeness scales; spontaneous conformal breaking identifies the waterfall with a dilaton-like mode, represented gravitationally by the radion. Relevant waterfall-sector operators correspond to AdS tachyonic scalars.

sources.title: Simple exercises to flatten your potential

evidence.text: Integrate out heavy directions approximately by solving ∂V/∂φ_H=0, substitute their field-dependent minima, and determine the canonical inflaton variable. Estimate the omitted heavy-field dynamics and the source produced by the light-field kinetic term separately.

sources.title: Tunnelling in Dante's Inferno

evidence.text: Semiclassical false-vacuum decay is described by Γ/Vol≈A exp(−B), with B the Euclidean bounce action minus the starting-state action. The authors include Einstein gravity and impose an O(4)-symmetric radial ansatz to estimate gravitational effects.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Evaluate the assumed Gaussian jump exponent and add the logarithm of the available patch multiplicity. Requiring an order-one expected count gives a duration scale proportional to C²(M_P/H_end)².

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: The local model isolates how quickly classical acceleration restores inflaton motion after an uphill turnaround. It freezes the positive potential energy and force while keeping both scalar acceleration and Hubble friction.

sources.title: Rejuvenating the hope of a swampland consistent inflated multiverse with tachyonic inflation in the high-energy RS-II braneworld

evidence.text: Can a noncanonical tachyon inflaton and the high-energy RS-II expansion law jointly remove the distance, de Sitter, fluctuation-amplitude and horizon-entropy obstacles that the paper reviews for ordinary single-field inflation?

sources.title: New old inflation

evidence.text: Can a single false-vacuum tunneling event followed by finite, dynamically locked inflation solve cosmological problems without slow-roll inflatons, while providing reheating, density perturbations, and dilution of dangerous moduli?

sources.title: Inflation and eternal inflation

evidence.text: How do inflation and its eternal continuation work, what historical arguments support inflation, and how can predictions be extracted when an infinite population of pocket universes makes probabilities ambiguous?

sources.title: Warm inflation solution to the eta problem

evidence.text: Can dissipation during inflation satisfy slow-roll and density-perturbation requirements with mφ≫H, η≫1 and sub-Planckian inflaton amplitudes, thereby avoiding the usual eta problem without symmetry protection of an exceptionally flat potential?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures and single-field inflation in nonstandard cosmological scenarios

evidence.text: Can changes to the Friedmann equation allow a canonical inflaton to traverse an order-one field distance on a steep potential while producing sufficient inflation and acceptable spectra?

sources.title: Is asymptotically safe inflation eternal?

evidence.text: Does asymptotic safety permit eternal inflation in gravitational and matter-sector examples, and can local potential criteria capture eternal inflation caused by crossing barriers between different inflationary branches?

sources.title: Rejuvenating the hope of a swampland consistent inflated multiverse with tachyonic inflation in the high-energy RS-II braneworld

evidence.text: Can an upward stochastic inflaton fluctuation, which raises H and reduces the prescribed horizon area entropy, remain compatible with the entropy-loss bound and an order-one potential-gradient constraint?

sources.title: Implication of the swampland distance conjecture on the Cohen–Kaplan–Nelson bound in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can competition between slow-roll horizon growth and matter-induced contraction diagnose whether inflation ends?

sources.title: Self-sustained, out-of-equilibrium inflation

evidence.text: Can expansion-induced, out-of-equilibrium stress in a non-conformal QFT sustain exponential expansion while satisfying H ≪ M ≪ Msp, without a fundamental inflaton?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: At what inflaton value does a quartic potential make quantum fluctuations competitive with classical drift during an early inflationary stage?

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How far can a canonical inflaton move while its Hubble scale remains below a cutoff lowered by an SDC tower?

sources.title: On inflation and axionic dark matter in a scaled gravity

evidence.text: Can identifying a constant gravity-rescaling parameter with an inflaton-potential exponent produce acceptable slow-roll observables, and what scale hierarchy follows if that inflaton is interpreted as an axion-like dark-matter field?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation, Entropy Bounds and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a canonical scalar near a positive cosine maximum support stochastic eternal inflation and subsequently enter a sufficiently long, observationally acceptable rolling phase?

sources.title: Is the NANOGrav signal a hint of dS decay during inflation?

evidence.text: Could conjecturally short inflationary vacuum lifetimes motivate observable transitions between inflationary stages?

sources.title: From the Big Bang theory to the theory of a stationary universe

evidence.text: Can self-reproducing chaotic inflation approach a stationary statistical description, despite continuing expansion and nonstationary comoving fields? The paper distinguishes recurring local domain properties from global stationarity of probability distributions.

sources.title: S-dual quintessence, the Swampland, and the DESI DR2 results

evidence.text: What mechanism could provide the order-fa initial displacement when quantum-sized hilltop seeds grow too slowly?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Does suppression of tensors also guarantee that the inflaton excursion lies below the conjectural bound?

sources.title: Stochastic eternal inflation is in the swampland

evidence.text: Do explicit fluctuation-control requirements similarly restrict inflation when extra degrees of freedom affect scalar dynamics, as in warm inflation, or when the inflating source is not a fundamental scalar? The paper identifies these questions without answering them.

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and (Anti) de Sitter bounds

evidence.text: Under what conditions can quantum fluctuations sustain inflation in spacetime dimension d≥4?

sources.title: Monopoles as big as a universe

evidence.text: Can primordial monopole interiors inflate, survive the end of inflation outside, and seed eternal self-reproduction despite conventional estimates based on small vacuum monopole sizes?

sources.title: Lorentz violating inflation and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a preferred timelike background change inflaton dynamics enough to reconcile cold single-field inflation with distance and potential-gradient conjectures while leaving the Einstein–Hilbert gravitational sector intact?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can a rare upward fluctuation overcome the end-of-inflation classical motion and restart inflation in some of the many previously generated Hubble patches?

sources.title: Lorentz-Violating Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can changing the inflaton kinetic sector through Lorentz violation preserve essentially GR inflation while allowing sufficient slow-roll expansion under the original de Sitter gradient and distance bounds?

sources.title: Hyperinflation generalised: from its attractor mechanism to its tension with the ‘swampland conditions’

evidence.text: Determine which geometric, potential and initial-condition assumptions are essential for rapid-turn inflation, and whether relaxing them permits models compatible with scalar observations and the particular quantum-gravity conjectures examined in the paper.

sources.title: Spinodal solution to swampland inflationary constraints

evidence.text: Can inflation controlled partly by growing quantum fluctuations satisfy cosmological requirements while avoiding restrictions inferred from potential-driven evolution? The paper examines spinodal natural inflation while provisionally assuming two swampland conjectures.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Inflation in Grand Unified Theories

evidence.text: What dynamics prepare the inflaton below the hilltop with a sufficiently small velocity, and what explains the tiny gauge coupling and flat potential?

sources.title: Fencing in the Swampland: Quantum Gravity Constraints on Large Field Inflation

evidence.text: Can weak-gravity-satisfying instantons be negligible during inflation? The setting separates the spectrum enforcing the full hull from terms dominating the inflaton potential.

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an initially uphill inflaton undergo self-sustaining quantum domination near a turnaround even when its potential has a steep slope? The mechanism seeks a finite-time alternative to the usual suppression of classical drift by a shallow potential.

sources.title: Supercritical String Cosmology drains the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the dilaton flow of a linear-expansion endpoint be used during an inflationary non-critical phase? The paper assumes the same coefficient in φ∝ln a while also imposing potential domination and q≈−1.

sources.title: Constant-roll brane inflation

evidence.text: The setting asks how a canonical inflaton evolves when brane gravity adds a quadratic energy-density contribution to the Friedmann equation and allows bulk gravitational effects.

sources.title: Topological defects as seeds for eternal inflation

evidence.text: How does the inflationary mechanism determine global phase geometry, and can topological defects inflate, reproduce and provide persistent seeds of eternal inflation?

sources.title: On Exclusion of Positive Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Does finite quantum breaking time exclude an eternally constant positive vacuum energy if quantum breaking must never occur? How does the resulting variation bound relate to a constant-coefficient potential-gradient criterion, and how restrictive is it for inflation and dark energy?

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Can controlled quantum-gravity examples decisively realize or exclude the scalar-potential and lifetime regimes that support eternal inflation?

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: The framework asks how restrictions motivated by quantum gravity constrain scalar potentials used for cosmological inflation.

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Could a prohibition of eternal inflation explain restrictions on positive scalar potentials in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Quantum cosmology, eternal inflation, and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: How do tunneling nucleation, the scalar quantum state, and stochastic eternal inflation change beyond slow roll near a potential maximum? Do their transition thresholds coincide when m/H is of order one?

sources.title: Quantum Breaking Bound on de Sitter and Swampland

evidence.text: Could primordial inflationary perturbations test quantum-breaking avoidance when dark-energy variation is difficult to observe? The paper proposes this direction and refers to earlier correction estimates, but gives no quantitative prediction or comparison with data.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can self-reproducing inflation coexist with a finite effective-theory field range and a lower bound on the gradient of a positive scalar potential? The paper studies this compatibility conditionally, with explicit calculations for one slowly rolling inflaton.

sources.title: Eternal Hilltop Inflation

evidence.text: Can hilltop potentials support eternal inflation when their quantum-dominated field interval is finite, including at arbitrarily low inflationary energy scales? The relevant competition is escape from that interval versus exponential production of inflating Hubble patches.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation, Entropy Bounds and the Swampland

evidence.text: The setting describes inflation driven by a canonical scalar whose local homogeneous value undergoes classical drift and quantum fluctuations.

sources.title: Power spectrum of density perturbations in chain inflation

evidence.text: The illustration asks how stochastic inflaton evolution can be evaluated inside the past light cone of an observer at time \(10H^{-1}\). Physical position and time are displayed in Hubble units, with the evaluation point at the top.

sources.title: Rejuvenating the hope of a swampland consistent inflated multiverse with tachyonic inflation in the high-energy RS-II braneworld

evidence.text: The setting replaces an ordinary scalar inflaton by a square-root tachyon field. Its kinetic normalization matters when translating potential derivatives, field excursions and quantum fluctuation amplitudes into swampland and eternal-inflation criteria.

sources.title: Axion monodromy inflation, trapping mechanisms and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a small periodic correction produce enough inflaton quanta to slow a steep background? The correction enters both the homogeneous force and the time-dependent fluctuation mass.

sources.title: Power spectrum of density perturbations in chain inflation

evidence.text: How can vacuum tunneling support prolonged inflation while still producing a hot universe? Chain inflation distributes the inflationary duration over many short-lived vacua, allowing bubbles from each transition to collide and release radiation.

How does the inflationary mechanism determine global phase geometry, and can topological defects inflate, reproduce and provide persistent seeds of eternal inflation?

destination.title: Primordial perturbations and CMB tests of inflation
destination.question: How do inflationary dynamics and perturbation-generation prescriptions affect primordial observables, and what can source-dated CMB tests and explicitly stated consistency conditions tell us about them?
destination.summary: A proposed navigation family spanning observational inference, spectral mechanisms, non-Gaussianity and alternative perturbation origins, with linked applications to conjectural consistency and reheating.

sources.title: Oscillations in the inflaton potential?

evidence.text: Can small periodic features in an otherwise smooth inflaton potential be constrained by WMAP5, and what amplitudes could the then-future Planck and a cosmic-variance limited CMB experiment detect?

sources.title: Kahler moduli double inflation

evidence.text: Can two Kähler inflatons produce successive inflationary stages whose weak interaction preserves information about the first stage as a sharp curvature-spectrum peak, and can such a peak improve the historical WMAP7 temperature-spectrum fit near ℓ ≃ 40?

sources.title: Constraining Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Do WMAP9 observations favor a periodically modulated linear monodromy potential over unmodulated linear inflation, and could the associated resonant bispectrum provide a consistency test?

sources.title: Warming up for Planck

evidence.text: Can relations among CMB scalar, tensor, and baryon-isocurvature observables distinguish a thermal origin of primordial perturbations from conventional quantum fluctuations, and test low-temperature supersymmetric warm inflation and warm baryogenesis?

sources.title: Planck 2013 results. XXII. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: What do the first Planck temperature measurements imply for primordial scale dependence, tensors, inflationary potentials, reheating uncertainty, spectral features, and departures from adiabatic initial conditions?

sources.title: Planck Constraints on Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Does the nominal 2013 Planck dataset support primordial oscillations associated with axion monodromy inflation, including the feature previously reported in WMAP9, once the frequency search and theoretical validity limits are considered?

sources.title: Non-Gaussianity in D3-brane inflation

evidence.text: What primordial bispectrum does delicate D3/anti-D3 inflation produce, particularly on trajectories with acceptable CMB spectra, and how sensitive are predictions to choices in constructing and sampling the potential?

sources.title: Holographic spacetime model of inflation and its predictions for the CMB primordial spectra

evidence.text: Can modular-Hamiltonian entropy fluctuations and Kerr angular-momentum fluctuations normalize the primordial scalar and tensor spectra of holographic space-time inflation while satisfying the CMB constraints quoted by the authors?

sources.title: Natural inflation, Planck scale physics and oscillating primordial spectrum

evidence.text: Can Planck-scale corrections to a natural-inflation potential generate oscillating or scale-dependent primordial spectra, and could their signatures survive transfer into CMB temperature, polarization, and matter spectra?

sources.title: First year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe (WMAP) observations: Implications for inflation

evidence.text: What do first-year WMAP temperature and polarization observations imply about superhorizon initial fluctuations, single-field inflation, correlated CDM isocurvature, and possible features in the inflaton potential?

sources.title: Effects of cosmological moduli fields on cosmic microwave background

evidence.text: How does a primordial fluctuation of a modulus that later dominates and decays affect the CMB, the inference of inflationary parameters, and possible correlated baryon isocurvature signatures?

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Can a dissipating inflaton coupled to a thermal radiation bath satisfy assumed bounds on field excursion and potential slope while producing an acceptable scalar spectrum and tensor amplitude?

sources.title: Warm Inflation in the light of Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can dissipation allow a single inflaton to satisfy conjectured limits on its excursion and potential slope while producing a tensor-to-scalar ratio below the observational benchmark? The paper asks how the answer changes between weak dissipation, Q < 1, and strong dissipation, Q > 1.

sources.title: Warm pseudoscalar inflation

evidence.text: Can a pseudoscalar inflaton coupled directly to light SU(2) gauge fields sustain warm inflation while avoiding dangerous thermal corrections, and produce acceptable scalar/tensor perturbations and small non-Gaussianity in a dissipative regime with f<Mp?

sources.title: Runaway potentials in warm inflation satisfying the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can generalized exponential runaway potentials support strongly dissipative warm inflation with a graceful exit, observationally acceptable perturbations, and simultaneous compatibility with the distance, de Sitter, and Transplanckian Censorship conjectures?

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can four strongly interacting composite-inflaton models satisfy a combined potential-derivative conjecture while retaining acceptable scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Oscillations in the inflaton potential?

evidence.text: Numerically solve the coupled homogeneous Friedmann and scalar-field equations. Estimate the curvature spectrum with the horizon-crossing approximation, including the displayed slow-roll corrections evaluated at k = aH; perturbation modes are not directly integrated.

sources.title: Kahler moduli double inflation

evidence.text: Uses the leading diagonal Kähler metric and a field redefinition to obtain canonical kinetic terms. Evolves homogeneous fields together with the linear Newtonian-gauge metric and field perturbations, decomposing the quantum fluctuations into a matrix of mode functions ψij.

sources.title: Constraining Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: MultiNest nested sampling handles narrow, multimodal likelihood structure and computes Bayesian evidence E=∫P(α)L(α)dα with a normalized prior. The comparison model is the purely linear potential V=μ³φ.

sources.title: Warming up for Planck

evidence.text: Use slow-roll background equations and evolution equations for the dissipative ratio and potential slow-roll parameters, calculate spectral indices and their runnings, and eliminate model parameters to obtain observable consistency relations separately for weak and strong dissipation.

sources.title: Planck 2013 results. XXII. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: Bayesian parameter estimation uses CosmoMC or MontePython MCMC, with MultiNest nested sampling for evidence or strongly non-Gaussian likelihoods. Model comparison reports both best-fit effective χ² differences and prior-averaged Bayesian evidence.

sources.title: Planck Constraints on Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: The spectrum uses the square-root field–e-fold relation for φk rather than expanding it into oscillations periodic in log k. The authors say this distinction becomes noticeable across Planck's multipole range, although it was unimportant for WMAP.

sources.title: Running Spectral Index from Inflation with Modulations

evidence.text: Can repeated small modulations of an inflaton potential generate a sizable negative running across CMB scales while retaining prolonged slow-roll inflation, and what subsequent small-scale spectrum would distinguish this mechanism?

sources.title: Cosmological Collider Physics

evidence.text: Which primordial non-Gaussian signatures distinguish particles with masses comparable to H from inflaton self-interactions, and reveal their masses, spins and quantum production?

sources.title: Minimal warm inflation and TCC

evidence.text: Does minimal warm inflation with a hybrid-form potential have parameter space compatible with Planck 2018 CMB data and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture, when its model-specific primordial spectrum is fitted directly?

sources.title: The zoo plot meets the swampland: mutual (in)consistency of single-field inflation, string conjectures, and cosmological data

evidence.text: How close to scale invariance is the scalar spectrum, and how much primordial tensor power remains allowed by the CMB observations quoted in this paper?

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. X. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: What do the Planck 2018 CMB measurements imply for inflationary observables, single-field dynamics, primordial spectral features, adiabaticity and statistical isotropy?

sources.title: What would we learn by detecting a gravitational wave signal in the cosmic microwave background anisotropy?

evidence.text: What would detecting inflationary gravitational waves in CMB anisotropy imply for the inflaton field excursion, potential height, and compatibility with particle-physics models?

sources.title: The quantum de Sitter root of quasi de Sitter observables

evidence.text: Can the scalar spectral tilt at CMB scales be determined from pure de Sitter quantum information, as a universal anomalous scaling exponent, without selecting an inflaton potential?

sources.title: Enhanced Non-Gaussianity from Excited Initial States

evidence.text: Can inflationary non-Gaussianity probe excited initial quantum states more sensitively than the power spectrum, and can enhancements from early sub-Hubble interactions survive projection into the CMB angular bispectrum while respecting backreaction and EFT limits?

sources.title: Planck 2015 results. XX. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: What do full-mission Planck CMB measurements imply for inflationary spectra, potential models, primordial tensors, spectral features and nonadiabatic initial conditions?

sources.title: Primordial thermal gravitational waves from warm inflation

evidence.text: Can an assumed thermal squeezed graviton state on a warm-inflation background modify primordial tensor and CMB BB spectra in a way compatible with the Planck/BK18 constraints used by the paper?

sources.title: Generation of inflationary perturbations in the continuous spontaneous localization model: The second order power spectrum

evidence.text: Can a scalar spectrum computed through second order in Hubble flow functions distinguish the scale dependence generated by continuous spontaneous localization from ordinary spectral running, and produce distinguishable CMB predictions?
